note: Both sets capture the core elevations and room containment, but Set A also correctly records the sheet number A-302, sheet title BUILDING SECTIONS, lot number 116, and the A1/C1 scales, which Set B omits. Set B adds several vague or misbound claims (CENTRE MODULE 'location K' where K is a grid line, MECHANICAL ROOM 'location Building Section A302', WEST MODULE 'location West', and generic 'building section contains room' entries) plus repeated duplicate finished-floor claims. Both sets share one misread value: the Living Room finished floor is 2' - 9 1/2" in the source, not 2' - 3 1/2". Set A's only other weakness is a quote for the West/Centre adjacency that does not itself support the relation.
